candidate_sentence_map.S1: SAF Tehnika’s performance improved substantially for the full 2024/2025 financial year, although the Group remained unprofitable and the fourth quarter weakened.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Annual net sales declined by 4% to EUR 26.11 million from EUR 27.09 million, reflecting lower revenue in the Americas, while European sales increased.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Despite the lower turnover, the net loss narrowed to EUR 820 thousand from EUR 2.37 million in the previous financial year.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: The operating loss improved to EUR 754 thousand from EUR 2.26 million, supported by a significant reduction in direct production costs and lower total operating expenses.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Financial items also remained a relatively small expense at EUR 62 thousand, compared with EUR 90 thousand previously.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The regional sales mix changed materially.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Revenue from North and Latin America fell 14% to EUR 14.28 million and represented 55% of annual turnover.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: European revenue increased 17% to EUR 10.04 million, accounting for 38% of sales, while revenue from Asia, Africa and the Middle East decreased 5% to EUR 1.78 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: In the fourth quarter, sales declined 13% year on year to EUR 5.18 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: North and Latin American turnover fell 40% to approximately EUR 2.5 million, partly offset by a 24% increase in Europe to EUR 1.9 million and a doubling of sales in Asia, Africa and the Middle East to EUR 846 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Quarterly results were affected by the timing and completion of individual projects, with production, procurement and revenue recognition sometimes extending into later quarters.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The Group recorded a net loss of EUR 913 thousand, compared with EUR 498 thousand in the prior-year quarter, while EBIT declined to a loss of EUR 863 thousand from EUR 495 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: EBITDA was negative EUR 460 thousand, compared with negative EUR 96 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Higher foreign-exchange losses and increased bonus costs contributed to the quarterly deterioration.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: For the full year, salaries, bonuses and related social expenses increased 8% to EUR 12.41 million, although total expenses remained within budget.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The Group continued investing in product development, product enhancements and sales promotion.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Operating activities generated EUR 2.13 million, compared with EUR 939 thousand previously, and total cash flow was positive EUR 2.60 million versus negative EUR 1.25 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Cash increased to EUR 4.81 million, supported also by EUR 3.92 million in customer advances, while the EUR 4.95 million Luminor credit line remained unused.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Inventory increased 8% as the Group maintained reserves to address electronic-component shortages and support delivery times, which have recently improved.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: SAF Tehnika continued developing microwave, spectrum-analyzer and IoT products amid stable market conditions and maintained a cautious outlook because of broader business uncertainty.

evaluation.label: Yes
evaluation.justification: All HIGH importance criteria (K1-K5) are fully represented with core material meaning covered. K6 and K7 (MEDIUM) are also present. K8 (MEDIUM) is missing entirely - no mention of fixed asset investments. Despite this single omission, the overall coverage is strong with all major financial, regional, operational, and liquidity elements present, justifying a 'Yes' (score 4).
